description: This file declares the interface for the dmProviderDatabase class, which manages provider information and queries related to device management in a software project. It includes method declarations for creating queries and retrieving provider info by various attributes, as well as private helper functions for loading data from a directory and constructing internal data structures.

classes.name: dmProviderDatabase
classes.description: A class responsible for managing provider data, supporting query creation and provider info retrieval by various identifiers.

methods.name: dmProviderDatabase
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider database with a directory path.

methods.name: createQuery
methods.description: Creates a new dmQuery object with a specified operation and string argument.

methods.name: getProviderByProviderName
methods.description: Retrieves provider information by provider name.

methods.name: getProviderByModelName
methods.description: Retrieves provider information by model name.

methods.name: getProviderByPropertyName
methods.description: Retrieves provider info by property name, optionally indicating if it's a list item.

methods.name: getProviderByObjectName
methods.description: Retrieves provider info by object name, optionally indicating if it's a list item.

methods.name: loadFromDir
methods.description: Loads data from a directory to populate the database.

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Loads provider info from a given file within a directory.

methods.name: makeProviderInfo
methods.description: Creates a provider info object from a JSON string.

methods.name: buildProviderTree
methods.description: Builds internal data structures for provider information.
